# Every gate in this repository

57 checks. Regenerate with `node scripts/build-gates-index.mjs`;
`--check` fails when this file is stale, so a new gate has to appear here.

**Read this before writing a new guard.** Four times in one campaign a check
was written that already existed elsewhere and better, because nothing listed
what was already here.

## `scripts/`

| gate | what it fails on |
|---|---|
| `check-admin-promotions-are-gated.mjs` | Every assignment that makes somebody an administrator must sit behind a gate. |
| `check-base-image-pulls-retry.mjs` | Every step that builds images pre-pulls its base images, retried. |
| `check-browser-installs-are-bounded.mjs` | Every `playwright install` in CI retries, and each attempt is bounded. |
| `check-ci-job-timeouts.mjs` | Every CI job declares how long it may run. |
| `check-ci-matrices-agree.mjs` | The UI submodule's integration matrix must cover everything the parent's does. |
| `check-ci-runs-lockfile-versions.mjs` | A CI step that runs `npm install <pkg>@<version>` overrides what the lockfile resolves, so CI exercises a different version of that package than every developer and every other job. |
| `check-color-tokens-exist.mjs` | Every `bg-*` / `text-*` / `border-*` token a component uses must exist in the Tailwind colour config. |
| `check-crate-coverage.mjs` | Fails if a Cargo workspace member has no cargo-fmt, cargo-clippy or test job. |
| `check-destructive-contrast.mjs` | Fails if destructive TEXT is below WCAG AA on any background it is read on. |
| `check-doc-assertions.mjs` | Checks `verify:` annotations — the escape hatch for claims that prose makes and no extractor can read. |
| `check-doc-commands.mjs` | Fails if the docs tell you to run something that does not exist. |
| `check-doc-file-refs.mjs` | Fails when a doc points at a source file that no longer exists. |
| `check-doc-setup-steps.mjs` | Fails if the stack REQUIRES configuration the quickstart never tells you to create. |
| `check-docker-workspace-manifest.mjs` | The production server image builds against a SUBSTITUTE root manifest. |
| `check-dockerfiles-copy-every-crate.mjs` | Every Rust workspace member must be COPY'd into every image that runs cargo. |
| `check-esm-imports-have-extensions.mjs` | In an ESM package, a relative import that runs must name a file Node can find. |
| `check-every-gate-is-invoked.mjs` | Every `check-*.mjs` must be invoked by something. |
| `check-every-integration-spec-has-a-runner.mjs` | Every integration spec must be named by an npm script that runs it. |
| `check-file-length.mjs` | The 250-line cap on UI source files. |
| `check-gates-have-their-dependencies.mjs` | A gate that imports a package must run in a job that installs one. |
| `check-gates-run-on-the-oldest-node.mjs` | A gate may not use an API newer than the Node this repository supports. |
| `check-generated-artefacts-present.mjs` | The checks that follow consume generated artefacts. |
| `check-generated-types-fresh.mjs` | The hand-copied TypeScript bindings must match the generated ones. |
| `check-group-handlers-are-authorized.mjs` | Every group-chat request handler must ask a group authorization gate first. |
| `check-handlers-cannot-panic.mjs` | A panic in a request handler is a request that hangs for ever. |
| `check-hover-only-controls.mjs` | No control may be revealed by hover alone. |
| `check-icon-button-names.mjs` | Fails if an icon-only Button has no accessible name. |
| `check-image-fetches-retry.mjs` | A network fetch in an image build is retried. |
| `check-images-build-what-the-lockfile-says.mjs` | An image that compiles this workspace must copy the lockfile. |
| `check-intent-results-checked.mjs` | An intent whose result reports failure must have that result read. |
| `check-listener-fanouts-are-isolated.mjs` | A fan-out over listeners must not let one of them silence the rest. |
| `check-message-storage-has-one-owner.mjs` | A room's message keys are built in exactly one module. |
| `check-network-fetches-are-bounded.mjs` | A retry bounds failures. |
| `check-nginx-headers-are-complete.mjs` | Every nginx location that serves content must carry the same headers as `/`. |
| `check-no-nested-npm-ci-in-workspaces.mjs` | `npm ci` inside a directory that is already a root workspace re-resolves that subtree and unhoists the root's devDependencies. |
| `check-no-test-features-shipped.mjs` | No shipped binary may be built with a test-only cargo feature. |
| `check-peer-list-timeout-parity.mjs` | The browser must not give up on peer discovery before the agent does. |
| `check-permission-parity.mjs` | The Permission enum exists twice: authoritatively in Rust (citadel-workspace-types) and mirrored in TypeScript for the admin UI. |
| `check-preview-csp-matches-production.mjs` | The CSP `npm run preview` serves must be the one nginx serves. |
| `check-production-image.mjs` | Drives a real browser against the real production image. |
| `check-required-env-is-documented.mjs` | Every value production REQUIRES from `.env` must be in `.env.example`. |
| `check-responsive-label-loss.mjs` | A control's only text may not be hidden by a responsive `hidden` class. |
| `check-restart-policies.mjs` | Every long-running service must declare a restart policy. |
| `check-rust-modules-are-compiled.mjs` | Every .rs file under a crate's src/ must be reachable by a `mod` declaration. |
| `check-sender-identity.mjs` | A message's sender must come from the transport, never from its payload. |
| `check-service-logs-are-captured.mjs` | A job that starts the stack must dump its logs when a test fails. |
| `check-session-teardown-prunes-cid-state.mjs` | Every place a session leaves `server_connection_map` must also prune the CID-keyed kernel maps (pending peer signals, username cache). |
| `check-stack-reachable.mjs` | Verify the running stack is reachable FROM THIS MACHINE, not from inside a container. |
| `check-storage-keys.mjs` | Fails if the UI reads a storage key nothing ever writes. |
| `check-submodule-pointers-pushed.mjs` | Every submodule pointer this repo records must exist on that submodule's remote. |
| `check-submodules-are-populated.mjs` | A clone without `--recurse-submodules` cannot build, and does not say so. |
| `check-third-party-images-are-pinned.mjs` | A third-party image in a compose file must name a version, not float. |
| `check-token-contrast.mjs` | Every semantic foreground must clear WCAG AA on the surface it names. |
| `check-transfer-cap-parity.mjs` | The inline-upload byte cap is declared in two languages and nothing bound them. |
| `check-wasm-matches-its-source.mjs` | The committed WASM binary must have been built from the committed source. |
| `check-workflow-npm-scripts-exist.mjs` | Every `npm run X` in the workflow must name a script that exists where it runs. |
| `check-workspace-missing-parity.mjs` | "No workspace found" is a sentinel the client matches on, written by a server that does not know it is one. |
